book.name: 2 Utimoti
book.title: Ubvur uwu uvaa Uburhu aka atsɛnge Utimoti

content: Idɔsu Unum ri inum iyiki imimasha
Aze ungo uhwɛng ugɛ ri inum iyiki imasha ayetnum awuri iwe akarhãrhã.
Anera awuri ibema atsimbɔ, awuri ibemu uhwɛk, awuri iwu abika afufĩrhã, abika akwɛr ikɔ, abika ahong inyar, asi ídɔsumbɔ arherhe ateimbɔ, asi ítarmbɔ uwɛɛ, asi ísarmbɔ,
awuri ishimbɔ ri ibibema, asi ítsũwũkumbɔ adɔka ra amɛnmbɔ, abika adakuwe atsok abɔɔ, asi íkpɔmmbɔ atsimbɔ, abi amɛn aka atsoo, asi íbemumbɔ iyiki ize,
abika agha-dak, abika ashera amɛn, abi iberi itsi, abika abee igũibɛn anangmbɔ ibemu Unum,
abika adɔsa ra asu anera, bɔr atsɛyimbɔ ijeengge. Niba ukorhungo ubin nggu ikpũmbɔ.
Ru umbɔ ha awu ikpũ abika akpo atsĩndĩ itsĩ ra aya anera na arhɛm akatsɛrh abika asheri itsoi, abirabɛ arhim aka awe ra atsimbɔ, nu ubɛn ikpũ ikponi iyiki ibewe iyiki ikũ amɛnmbɔ iyarhe.
Akatsɛrh abɛrɛ ha awu abirabɛ ubɛn unum umbɔ adɛ̃ɛ̃ imimesa, bɔr asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ atsĩmbɔ ri ihwɛng idzidzɛrhe.
Ru nyaka Ujeni nu Ujambra aka akpɛ̃ Umusa, rimi hã aner abɛrɛ aka akpɛ̃ idzidzɛrhe. Aner abɛrɛ akaifɛrhkɔ abin aka abewe. Aka agbambɔ ri imangmangmbɔ.
Bɔr asi ízĩ adermbɔ, ubinkutsu anera kishoo awuri ihwɛngmbɔ aguggembɔ, ru nyaka anera aka ahwɛng agugge umbɔ Ujeni nu Ujambra.
Bɔr ungo, uku udɔsungo kishoo imesamum, ikpũ ibibɛkmum, nu ubinkpi umum iki ibee ikorhe ri ibibɛkmum. Nu imangmangmum nu idɔng amɛnmum, nu ibibemamum, nu ibibimamum.
Umbi ahwɛngmbi uverkpi nu ayetnumkɛ aka akpo umum ru Uantakiya, nu Uikoniya nu Urhistira. Umum iki ibima ru uver ha. Rimi hã, Uteijee ashɔɔrka umum ra ake kishoo.
Idzidzɛrhe, ubɛn uwuku ubee ibibɛk iyi Unum aka abee ru Ukiristo Uyesu awuri ihwaa uver.
Bɔr abika abewe nu abika arhurhɛm awuri itoma agha inggbaashe, utirhi ri iyiki ibewe azĩ atsĩ nggaa iyiki ibewe. Awuri irhɛm abɔɔ nu awuri irhɛmbɔ umbɔ.
Bɔr ungo, udɛ̃ɛ̃ ru ubinkpi ungo uku umesa nu udzowe imangmang ru ukpɔ, ubinkutsu ungo uhwɛngo abirabɛ ungo uku umesa ru umbɔ.
Ungo uhwɛngo ugɛ udzur ri ivangyɛ ungo uku una uwu uwɛkuci nu uhwɛng usarkasar itsɛng Arherhu-Num. Akirakɛ aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ amesuwa ungo utsĩndĩ uwuku ukpo ififɔrh ru ubok imangmang ru Ukiristo Uyesu.
Kishoo itsɛng Arherhu-Num awu irhɛmyɛ unga aka atsu ra amɛn abika atsɛng ngge na aze ri imimesuwe nu itsitsɛrhe, nu igbigbisha ru igbaigba nu imimesuwe ri irhirhika,
ngge itsú uner Unum ama adzuma agbisha akorhe ubɛn itser iyiki ize.
